focus: 站會交棒：每件事指名到人
lead: 今天練的是站會不只報進度，還要把事情交出去：講完狀態之後，每一條線都要有名字和日期，而且你要敢在會上說「這個我先擱置」。PM 的站會價值不在講得完整，而在講完之後房間裡的責任是清楚的。每個 speaking 段落請先出聲講完再看 model answer。

phrases.en: Quick recap, then two decisions I need.
phrases.gl: 先快速回顧，然後我需要兩個決定（一開口就把會議的目的講明）
phrases.ex: Quick recap, then two decisions I need — one on storage, one on the vehicle slots.

phrases.gl: 我們最後落在哪裡（用在一週的實驗或討論收斂之後）
phrases.ex: Where we landed is 78% cut-in recall, up from 71%, but false positives went up with it.

phrases.gl: 扣掉好壞相抵，淨結果是……（主管最想聽的一句）
phrases.ex: Net-net, that puts us one week ahead on recall and about three days behind on validation.

phrases.en: I'm parking X to protect Y.
phrases.gl: 我先擱置 X 來保住 Y（講取捨，而不是講「都在做」）
phrases.ex: I'm parking the rear-fisheye re-calibration to protect the milestone review.

phrases.gl: 負責人是誰、什麼時候到期（六個字結案，不要用一整段描述）
phrases.ex: Storage cleanup — owner is Grace, due Thursday, and she'll post the number in the channel.

phrases.en: Let me take one pass at it before we escalate.
phrases.gl: 我先處理一輪，不行再往上升（展現你有先擋一層）
phrases.ex: The labeling queue is stuck again — let me take one pass at it with Rachel before we escalate.

phrases.gl: 這個 sprint 它屬於「有更好，沒有也行」（明確降級，不是含糊拖著）
phrases.ex: The dashboard refresh is a nice-to-have this sprint — I'd rather spend the time on validation.
phrases.fix: 取代 “It is not so important, maybe we can do it later”

phrases.en: Flagging early, not asking for help yet.
phrases.gl: 我先預警，還不需要你出手（先報風險又不顯得慌）
phrases.ex: Storage is at 84% of the budget — flagging early, not asking for help yet.
phrases.fix: 取代 “Sorry to bother you, I think I have a problem…”

phrases.en: Anything there that doesn't match what you're seeing?
phrases.gl: 有哪裡跟你看到的不一樣嗎？（主動邀請校正，比 any question 有效十倍）
phrases.ex: That's my read on the false positives — anything there that doesn't match what you're seeing?

setup: Setup. Monday stand-up, mid-sprint, on the perception data programme. Last week's retrain moved cut-in recall from 71% to 78%, but false positives on parked vehicles went up by roughly a third, so the result is not clean. You have used 12 of your 20 vehicle slots for the quarter and the shared storage sits at 84% of the 40 TB budget, mostly old rosbags nobody has triaged. Kevin from hardware thinks the extra false positives come from your labeling, not from the rolling-shutter artefact you suspect on the front-left camera. David runs the stand-up and wants two decisions out of it; Grace owns data ops and Rachel coordinates the labeling vendor.

prompts.q: David: “Momo, kick us off. What happened with the retrain?”
prompts.frame: Say what you need from the meeting → where it landed → net-net → the trade-off you have already made.
prompts.say: 先出聲講完整段（目標 50 秒），開場第一句就要說你需要幾個決定。
prompts.model: “Quick recap, then two decisions I need. Where we landed is 78% cut-in recall, up from 71% — so the retrain worked. But false positives on parked vehicles went up about a third, so I can't ship it as-is. Net-net, that puts us ahead on recall and roughly three days behind on validation. I've already made one trade-off: I'm parking the rear-fisheye re-calibration to protect the milestone review, so please don't expect movement there this week. The two decisions I need are storage and vehicle slots — I'll come back to those at the end.”

prompts.q: Kevin: “I don't think it's rolling shutter. Honestly it looks like your labels are inconsistent on parked cars.”
prompts.frame: Take the challenge seriously → keep your read but attach evidence → propose the test that settles it → invite correction.
prompts.say: 出聲練習「被質疑但不縮」——不要說 “Maybe you are right, we will check again”。
prompts.model: “That's a fair challenge, and it's cheap to settle. Here's why I'm still leaning towards the camera: the extra false positives cluster on the front-left feed, and the other three cameras used the same label batch and look clean. If it were labeling, I'd expect it everywhere. So let's do this — Rachel pulls two hundred parked-car frames from the front-left and re-checks them blind, and in parallel I compare the same scenes against the front-right. That's a day of work and it tells us which of us is right. Anything there that doesn't match what you're seeing?”

prompts.q: David: “Storage is nearly full and I'm not buying more this quarter. What do you want to do?”
prompts.frame: State the constraint in numbers → name what you are dropping → assign each item to a person with a date → close the loop.
prompts.say: 出聲練習「在會上直接指派」，每一件事都必須以人名和日期收尾。
prompts.model: “Understood — then we clean instead of buy. We're at 84% of the 40 TB, and my estimate is about 6 TB of that is old rosbags from runs we've already validated. Two things. First, cleanup: owner is Grace, due Thursday, and she posts the recovered number in the channel so we're not guessing. Second, I'm parking the raw-bag retention for the daytime urban set — we keep the extracted clips, not the full bags. That's a nice-to-have this sprint and it buys us the headroom. On slots, I'm at 12 of 20 for the quarter and I'd rather hold four in reserve for the night re-runs, so I'll only book two this week. Flagging early on that, not asking for help yet.”

fixes.bad: Because the storage budget is almost full, so we stopped the night runs.
fixes.good: Because the storage budget is almost full, we've paused the night runs.
fixes.note: Grammar：中文的「因為…所以…」在英文只能留一個。用了 Because 就不要再接 so，否則整句聽起來像沒讀完的翻譯。

fixes.bad: I need more informations about the labeling vendor's queue.
fixes.good: I need more information on the labeling vendor's queue.
fixes.note: Plurals：information、feedback、equipment、progress 都是不可數，永遠沒有 s。要講「幾則」就說 a couple of updates。

fixes.bad: We are having three vehicle slots this week and I am knowing the schedule already.
fixes.good: We have three vehicle slots this week, and I already know the schedule.
fixes.note: Tense：have、know、need、want 這類狀態動詞不用進行式。中文會說「我正在知道」不通，英文也一樣。

fixes.bad: Please help me double confirm the vehicle slot before Wednesday.
fixes.good: Could you confirm the vehicle slot by Wednesday?
fixes.note: Register：double confirm 是台灣職場英文，母語者聽不懂它跟 confirm 的差別。確認只有一次，需要再追就直接說 I'll follow up Wednesday morning。

fixes.bad: The recall number dropped very obvious after the lens change.
fixes.good: The recall number dropped noticeably after the lens change.
fixes.note: Word form：修飾動詞要用副詞（noticeably、sharply、slightly），不是形容詞 obvious。想強調就換副詞，不要靠 very 疊上去。

challenge:
今天在真實 stand-up 中做這一件事：講完狀態後，至少交出一件事並指名到人 ——

“Quick recap, then ___ decision I need. Where we landed is ___. Net-net, that puts us ___. ___ — owner is ___, due ___.”

錄音作業（60 秒，手機錄）：用英文報一次你這週的真實進度，但這次的重點不是講完，而是交出去。

  • 開場第一句必須說明你需要幾個決定
  • 必須出現一次 “Net-net, that puts us…”，把好壞相抵後的淨結果講出來
  • 至少一件事要用「人名 + due + 日期」六個字收尾
  • 必須明確講出一個你正在擱置的東西（“I'm parking ___ to protect ___.”）
  • 禁用：double confirm、informations、Because…, so…、very obvious、maybe later
check: 我今天有沒有把至少一件事指派給具體的人並附上日期，而不是說「我們會處理」？
我有沒有講出一個明確的取捨（我擱置了什麼、為了保住什麼），而不是讓人以為所有事都在進行？
被質疑的時候，我有沒有守住自己的判斷並提出可以驗證的方法，而不是直接說 “maybe you are right”？
